claims.claim: The item is a high quality solar panel.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a large black metal mesh/grid panel, not a solar panel surface (no cells/lamination visible).
Witness photos show a mesh metal panel; no inverter casing, display, or ports visible.

claims.claim: The item is a lithium or tubular battery.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a metal grille/mesh sheet; no battery terminals, labels, or casing visible.

claims.claim: The item is a charge device (charger).
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a mesh metal panel; no charger body or connectors visible.

risks.risk: Wrong item category: the photos appear to be a metal mesh/grille panel, while the seller’s message is about solar/inverter/batteries.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the exact item being sold showing its front/back and any identifying features (e.g., solar cell grid for panels, inverter label for inverters, battery terminals/label for batteries).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-electrical metal mesh/grille panel (lowest value case) until the seller proves the item matches the intended electrical product.

risks.risk: Unknown dimensions and thickness (value depends heavily on size and gauge).
risks.proof: One photo with a measuring tape/known reference (e.g., ruler) showing height and width, plus a close-up showing thickness/gauge or a caliper measurement.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for smaller/thinner grille panels.

risks.risk: Condition issues not fully visible: rust, dents, bent frame, loose welds/fasteners, or corrosion under paint.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of corners/edges and any weld lines/fastener points, plus a photo in strong side lighting to reveal dents/bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/possibly damaged with no guarantee of structural integrity.

risks.risk: Material uncertainty (steel vs aluminum) affects corrosion risk and resale value.
risks.proof: A close-up showing material markings (if any) and a photo of a magnet test result (magnet sticks = likely steel).
risks.if_unproven: Price as steel with higher corrosion risk.

risks.risk: Whether it includes a frame/hinges/locks (if applicable) is unknown; that changes usability and price.
risks.proof: Photos showing the full perimeter and any frame, hinges, locks, or mounting points (front and back).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standalone mesh sheet with no frame/hardware.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the exact item for sale (front, back, edges) with a measuring tape showing height and width.
Show close-ups of corners/edges/welds/fasteners (if any) and any rust/corrosion spots.
Confirm the material (steel vs aluminum) with a magnet test photo or any label/marking.
If it is actually a solar panel/inverter/battery, send photos that clearly show the product type (solar cells, inverter label/ports, battery terminals/label) matching the item in the photos.
response.reason: The witness photos consistently show a metal mesh/grid panel, so it can be priced as that worst-case category; the seller’s electrical-product message is not supported by the observed item.
